verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents percentage rollouts via a % Split segment rule that takes values from 1 to 100, applied globally or within a segment, and flags change remotely without deploying new code. That covers ramping from 1% to 100% without a redeploy. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that bucketing is consistent/deterministic per user (sticky assignment as the percentage rises), and independent or hands-on corroboration of rollout behavior.
